user.title: Charger
user.description: What the charger reports. Pick the entities of your charger's own integration.

data.name: Name
data.failsafe_keeps_phase: Keep the phase on a sensor fault

data_description.applied_current_entity: The current limit the charger applies now, not the car's measured current.
data_description.active_phases_entity: Shows 1 or 3, or the same texts as the phase setting.
data_description.connection_entity: A Mode 3 sensor (A, B1–D2, E, F), or a binary sensor that is on while a car is connected.
data_description.max_current_entity: The charger's maximum current, e.g. its configured or installation maximum. Until it reports a value the fallback current is the maximum; never above 32 A.
data_description.fallback_current_a: Used after a sensor fault and when the car is unplugged.
data_description.fallback_phase: Phase count after a sensor fault and when the car is unplugged.
data_description.charger_energy_entity: Optional. The charger's own energy meter in kWh. Without it, charged energy is integrated from charger power.
data_description.current_step_a: The smallest current change the charger accepts.
data_description.widen_small_decreases: Turn on for Alfen chargers: they ignore some 0.1 A decreases.
data_description.failsafe_keeps_phase: Off (recommended): a sensor fault switches to 1 phase, so a charger that stops responding is not left on an unintended phase. On: the phase stays as it is.

controls.title: Charger controls
controls.description: Where the controller writes its setpoints while Control charger is on.

data.control_off_action: When Control charger is switched off

data_description.control_off_action: What the charger gets once when you switch Control charger off.

phases.title: Phase options
phases.description: Which option of the phase setting means 1 phase and which means 3 phases.

household.title: Household
household.description: The house power without the charger.

data_description.house_power_entity: Negative while exporting. It must not include the charger. A smoothed sensor works best.
data_description.solar_power_entity: Optional. Shown in diagnostics only; the controller uses the export in house power.
data_description.monthly_peak_entity: Optional. The highest quarter-hour average power of this month (capacity tariff). The power limit follows it when Follow monthly peak is on.

car.title: Car
car.description: Optional. Without a battery level the SOC targets do nothing.

price.title: Price and EMS
price.description: Optional. Without a price the price check is skipped.

data_description.price_entity: Import price in your currency per kWh.
data_description.price_attribute: Leave empty to use the sensor state.
data_description.ems_entity: Grid budget in watts, or on/off. 0 W blocks the grid.

tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.description: Fixed values that rarely need a change.

data_description.power_update_threshold_w: An increase is written only when it adds at least this much power. Decreases are always written.
data_description.phase_switch_delay_min: After a drop to 1 phase, wait this long before going back to 3 phases.
data_description.recalc_interval_s: How often the controller runs. Mode, setting, connection and phase changes run it at once.
data_description.peak_factor_pct: With Follow monthly peak on, the power limit may rise to this share of the monthly peak.

shared.title: Inputs shared with another controller

error.connection_not_mode3: This sensor does not show a Mode 3 state (A, B1–D2, E, F). Pick a Mode 3 sensor or a binary sensor.
error.phase_select_unavailable: The phase setting has no options. Check that the charger is online.
error.current_entity_in_use: Another charge controller already uses this current limit.
error.phase_entity_in_use: Another charge controller already uses this phase setting.
error.capacity_required: Enter the battery capacity when you pick a battery level sensor.
error.car_min_above_max: The car min current is higher than the car max current.
error.attribute_without_price: Pick a price sensor to use a price attribute.
error.price_attribute_missing: The price sensor has no attribute with this name.

charger_not_responding.title: {name}: the charger does not respond
charger_not_responding.description:
The charger did not follow the last 3 writes: its applied current or active phases did not change in time. The controller tries again at each run, and this issue closes when the charger follows again.

Check that the charger is online and that its integration works. To stop the attempts, switch Control charger off.
